title: TierEventPayload
description: Payload variants emitted under the `tier.event` schema.

RestoreCompletePayload.description:
JSONL event emitted when a restore completes (object is warm) during `crab hydrate`.

Schema: `"tier.event"` v `"1.0"`, event type: `"restore_complete"`.

class.description: Provider-native storage class of the object.

completed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the restore completed.

wait_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds spent waiting for the restore.

xorb_hash.description: Hex-encoded content hash of the restored xorb.

RestoreSubmitPayload.description:
JSONL event emitted when a restore request is submitted for an archived xorb during `crab hydrate`.

Schema: `"tier.event"` v `"1.0"`, event type: `"restore_submit"`.

class.description: Provider-native storage class of the archived object.

expected_ready_at.description: Estimated RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the object will be ready. `None` when the provider does not supply an estimate.

requested_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the restore was requested.

xorb_hash.description: Hex-encoded content hash of the xorb being restored.

StorageClass.description:
Provider-native storage class.

Covers S3, GCS, and Azure Blob classes that Crab interacts with. Unrecognised class strings from provider APIs map to [`Unknown`].

[`Unknown`]: StorageClass::Unknown

oneOf.description: Returned when the provider reports a class string we don't recognise. Treated as warm with no retention minimum.

TierPlanPayload.description:
Structured payload for `crab tier plan --json`.

Wraps the plan output with provider, rules, and versioning status for the `"tier.plan"` schema envelope.

object_lock_enabled.description: Whether object-lock is enabled on the bucket.

TierRulePayload.description: One lifecycle rule within the structured plan output.

min_object_size_bytes.description: Minimum object size in bytes for the filter.

noncurrent_expiration_days.description: Days after which noncurrent versions expire (versioned buckets).

prefix.description: Object key prefix this rule applies to.

TierTransitionPayload.description: A storage-class transition within a lifecycle rule.

days.description: Days after object creation before the transition fires.
